name: WP Zillow Review Slider
author: jgwhite33

sections.description:
Display Zillow Realtor Reviews on Your WordPress Website — Fast, Local & Built for Real Estate Agents and Brokerages.

WP Zillow Review Slider helps real estate agents, Realtors, teams, and brokerages turn Zillow client reviews into high-converting on-site testimonials and social proof. Instead of relying on slow external widgets on every page load, this plugin downloads your Zillow agent reviews once, stores them in your WordPress database (utf8mb4 emoji-ready) on your own server, and serves them locally for fast page speed and strong Core Web Vitals.

Home buyers and sellers research agents carefully before reaching out. Showcasing verified 5-star Zillow reviews and a Zillow rating summary badge on your agent bio page, home valuation landing page, or IDX property pages builds immediate trust and generates more listing and buyer leads.

Note: The free version supports Zillow Realtor / Agent profile reviews (zillow.com/profile/...). Zillow Lender/Mortgage and Contractor profiles are supported in WP Review Slider Pro.

Why Choose WP Zillow Review Slider?

  • Multi-Agent / Multi-Profile Support: Add multiple Zillow agent profile URLs on the Get Zillow Reviews page, download reviews for each agent separately, and choose which agent’s reviews each template displays — ideal for real estate teams and brokerages.
  • Zillow Summary Rating Badge: Place a customizable Zillow rating badge on the left, right, or above your reviews (or display the badge standalone) using the saved Zillow source average rating and total review count.
  • Built-In Review Analytics Dashboard: Track your average star rating, 1-to-5 star breakdown, review volume timeline, rating trends over time, and positive/negative keyword word clouds right inside wp-admin.
  • Stored Locally for Fast Page Speed: Zero external API calls on front-end page loads — built for SEO, IDX/real estate themes, and page caching.

How Zillow Reviews Work

  1. Open Get Zillow Reviews in your WordPress admin and paste your Zillow agent profile URL (for example https://www.zillow.com/profile/yourname).
  2. Click Download Reviews to import your Zillow client reviews into your WordPress database.
  3. Open Templates, customize your slider, grid, or summary badge with the live preview, then insert the WP Zillow Review Slider block or paste the shortcode into any post, page, agent bio, or widget area.

Key Features (Free Version)

  • Responsive Review Slider, Carousel, Grid & List: Display Zillow client reviews in an animated horizontal slider or a multi-row, multi-column responsive grid.
  • Two Modern Template Styles + Live Preview: Choose between Style 1 (classic speech bubble) and Style 6 (modern review card layout) in a tabbed template editor (Style, General, Filter, Badge) with live AJAX preview and save.
  • Zillow Summary Rating Badge: Display your overall Zillow star rating, total review count, agent photo/logo, and a “Review us on Zillow” button beside or above your reviews — or standalone.
  • Review List & Inline Editing: Manage all imported Zillow reviews in one table. Easily hide/show individual reviews, edit reviewer avatars and review dates inline, or delete reviews.
  • Smart Template Filtering: Filter reviews by minimum star rating (e.g., only 5-star reviews), hide reviews without text, sort by newest or random order, and select which Zillow agent profile a template displays.
  • Full Design Customization: Customize star colors, verified review badges, client last name format (full name, hidden, or initial), avatar style (initials avatar, mystery icon, uploaded photo, or hidden), Zillow logo link, font sizes, background/text colors, border radius, and custom CSS.
  • Slider & Layout Controls: Configure autoplay, slide speed and delay, show/hide navigation arrows and dots, mobile swipe support, one-review-per-slide mobile mode, equal-height review cards (Reviews Same Height), and expandable Read More links.
  • Display Anywhere: Embed unlimited review templates on agent bio pages, homepages, landing pages, or sidebars using the WP Zillow Review Slider block, a shortcode, a WordPress widget, or a PHP template function.

Check Out Our Other Free Review Slider Plugins

  • Google Reviews
  • Facebook & X (Twitter) Reviews
  • Yelp Reviews
  • TripAdvisor Reviews
  • Airbnb Reviews
  • Thumbtack Reviews
  • WooCommerce Product Reviews

Upgrade to WP Review Slider Pro for More Features

Want to download ALL of your Zillow reviews automatically every day and combine them with Realtor.com, Redfin, Google, Facebook, and Yelp reviews? Upgrade to WP Review Slider Pro:

  • Download ALL Zillow Reviews (Plus Mortgage & Contractor Profiles) & Daily Auto-Sync: Import your complete Zillow review history using multiple cloud and local download methods, and automatically check for new reviews on a daily cron schedule.
  • 150+ Review Sites (Including Realtor.com, Redfin, Google, Facebook & Yelp): Automatically import and combine real estate reviews from Zillow, Realtor.com, Redfin, Google Business Profile, Facebook, Yelp, Apartments.com, ApartmentRatings, LendingTree, Credit Karma, BBB, Nextdoor, Homestars, Houzz, Thumbtack, Experience.com, and 130+ more platforms!
  • Combine Multiple Agents & Platforms in One Slider: Mix reviews across your entire brokerage team or combine Zillow, Realtor.com, Redfin, and Google reviews into one unified testimonial slider — or filter dynamically by Post ID (e.g., per-agent bio pages), Category, or custom tags.
  • Custom Review Sources & AI Import: Add any real estate directory or MLS platform with your own custom name and logo, and use AI to extract and import reviews automatically.
  • AI Review Summaries & Deep AI Analysis: Display an AI-generated “Clients Say” summary in your template header or badge, run full AI Sentiment & SWOT Analysis reports (themes, pain points, client personas, and action items), and draft AI Agent Responses.
  • 15 Review Template Styles & Masonry Grids: Unlock 15 pre-built template styles, Masonry grids, continuous-scroll carousels, custom responsive breakpoints, and child-theme template overrides.
  • Interactive Front-End Header, Search & Pagination: Add a front-end search bar, sort dropdown, rating/source filter, tag filter pills, Load More button, Endless Scroll, or numbered pagination.
  • 7 Summary Badge Styles, Floating Badges & Slide-Out Drawers: Choose from 7 standalone badge designs, pin floating badges or review pop-ins to the corner of your site, and open a slide-out or pop-up review drawer on click.
  • Front-End Client Review Forms & Smart Review Gate: Collect client testimonials directly on your website with custom fields, closing photos/videos, and reCAPTCHA. Route happy clients to Zillow or Google while capturing low ratings privately.
  • Automated Review Request Emails (Autoresponders): Send branded review request emails to clients after closing with open/click tracking.
  • Shareable Social Media Review Cards & Email Signatures: Turn 5-star buyer and seller reviews into high-resolution PNG social graphics for Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn (with Google Fonts & Unsplash property backgrounds) and build live-rating email signatures for every email you send!
  • Google Rich Snippet Schema (JSON-LD), Auto-Translate, Webhooks & White-Label: Output valid JSON-LD AggregateRating schema markup, translate reviews via Google Translate API, send new reviews to Zapier, Make, or n8n via webhooks, sync with TrustGuide, import/export CSVs, and enable Agency White-Label Mode.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wp-zillow-review-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install WP Zillow Review Slider from Plugins → Add New in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open WP Zillow in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Go to Get Zillow Reviews, paste your Zillow agent profile URL (https://www.zillow.com/profile/yourname), and click Download Reviews.
  5. Visit Review List and Analytics to inspect your imported reviews and rating charts.
  6. Create a template on the Templates page, then insert the WP Zillow Review Slider block or add the shortcode to any agent bio page, post, or widget area.
sections.faq:
How do I display Zillow reviews on WordPress?

Install the plugin, paste your Zillow agent profile URL (https://www.zillow.com/profile/yourname) on the Get Zillow Reviews page, click Download Reviews, create a template on the Templates page, then insert the WP Zillow Review Slider block or paste the shortcode into any post, page, or widget area.

Can I show Zillow reviews as testimonials on my real estate website?

Yes! Real estate agents, Realtors, and brokerages use this plugin to turn verified Zillow client reviews into on-site testimonials and social proof on agent bio pages, buyer/seller landing pages, and homepages.

Are Zillow reviews stored on my server?

Yes. When you download reviews, they are saved in your WordPress database on your own server and served locally — not pulled from Zillow on every page view. That keeps your real estate website fast and cache-friendly.

Can I add more than one Zillow agent profile?

Yes. The free version lets you add multiple Zillow agent profile URLs on the Get Zillow Reviews page and download reviews for each source. Each template in the free version can display reviews for one chosen Zillow profile (perfect for individual agent pages), while WP Review Slider Pro also lets you combine multiple agents and 150+ platforms (including Realtor.com, Redfin, and Google) into one template.

Does the free version download reviews automatically every day?

In the free version, you download reviews manually whenever you want from the Get Zillow Reviews page. Daily automatic downloads are available in WP Review Slider Pro.

Can I use this for Zillow Mortgage / Lender or Contractor profiles?

The free version is designed for Zillow Realtor / Agent profile URLs. Mortgage, Lender, Contractor, and other Zillow profile types are supported in WP Review Slider Pro.

Zillow is blocking my download. What can I do?

Zillow’s firewall sometimes blocks direct requests from certain shared web hosting IP addresses. WP Review Slider Pro includes remote/cloud download methods that bypass hosting blocks and import all of your Zillow reviews reliably.

How do I request a new feature?

We are always looking for features to add! Post on the support forum or contact us on the WP Review Slider website.
sections.changelog:
4.8

  • Added a Setup Wizard, opened from the Welcome page, that downloads your Zillow reviews, helps you pick a look, and adds them to a page.
  • Added a Header Options tab on the Templates page that previews the Pro header, search, sort, and filter options.
  • Added a rating request to the admin footer on the plugin’s pages.
  • The Card style (Style 6) now uses fixed review text and date sizes, so it looks the same with any theme.
  • Fixed the Card style (Style 6) grid stacking into one column on some themes when the rating badge is beside the reviews.
  • Fixed the verified check mark sitting lower than the stars in the Card style (Style 6) with some themes.
  • The Zillow logo on Style 1 reviews is now 26px tall, the same as the Card style (Style 6).
  • The Zillow logo on reviews and badges is now a sharp SVG icon.
  • The logo in the Above Wide badge now lines up with the right edge of the button below it.

4.7

  • Added a WP Zillow Review Slider block so a saved template can be inserted in the block editor.
  • The block shows the selected template in the editor.
  • Edit Template in the block toolbar opens that template in a new tab.
  • Refresh in the block toolbar reloads the template preview.
  • Open Templates opens in a new tab and reminds you to refresh the editor after creating a template.

4.6

  • Checks the reviews table encoding on update and converts legacy utf8 (3-byte) tables to utf8mb4 so reviews containing emojis can be saved.
  • Fix for URLs with spaces

4.5

  • Changes to the opt-in feature.

4.4

  • Badge shows the Zillow source average and total review count saved for each location.

4.3

  • Zillow downloads now use the agent profile URL (https://www.zillow.com/profile/yourname). The old Write Review link no longer returns reviews.

4.2

  • Added a new Analytics page for review insights and charts.
  • Added Pro feature highlights and upgrade nudges throughout the admin.
  • Template Filter limited to one Zillow source in free (multi-location is Pro).

4.1

  • Fixed Style 6 so three reviews stay on one row when a side badge is shown.
  • Fixed Style 6 blank gap when Show Date is set to No.
  • Avatar options are now No, Mystery, or Initial (Zillow does not provide reviewer photos).
  • Improved Style 1 star alignment and badge spacing next to reviews.
  • Improved Templates admin: live slider preview CSS, Badge Settings layout, and help-text toggles.

4.0

  • New: Add multiple Zillow business pages and download reviews for each source separately from the Get Zillow Reviews page.
  • New: Choose which Zillow business page each review template displays reviews from.
  • New: Modern card review layout (Style 6) in addition to the classic style.
  • New: Review Template editor is now tabbed (Style, General, Filter, Badge) with a live preview, Slider/Grid settings (slide speed, autoplay, dots, arrows, static height), Read More links, and Reviews Same Height.
  • New: Verified badge, last name display (show/hide/initial), avatar options (hide/mystery/initial), and site icon display are all now configurable per template.
  • New: Badge Settings tab lets you place a Zillow rating badge (location, name, business image, colors, border, and text overrides) next to your reviews.
  • New: Filter By Rating setting is now active in the free version, letting you hide reviews below a chosen star rating.
  • Improved: Existing single Zillow Write Review URL setting is automatically migrated into the new multi-source list.
  • Improved: Hardened review queries and sanitized crawled data before saving.

3.4

  • WordPress 7 admin UI update: Welcome page, W3 tab bar, white content panels, and improved button styling.
  • Pagination and confirmation modal styling improvements.
  • README updates: local storage messaging and accurate Pro-only daily download info.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.0.

3.3

  • increase download to 10 reviews.

3.2

  • download review fix

3.1

  • download review fix
